tables.name: deposit
tables.description: Deposit account information for all MyMo-linked deposit accounts, transformed but with account_number left as raw PII. Loaded monthly (T-3, on the 3rd) from the cleansed dv_deposit_account HDFS file. Partitioned by year_month.

columns.name: account_group
columns.description: DDA, SAV, or CD. Corrected from the source doc's stated Decimal type -- see draft notes.

columns.name: account_number
columns.description: PII -- raw (unhashed) account number, padded to 10 or 12 digits depending on account_group

columns.name: relationship_code
columns.description: A = single, B = or, C = and

columns.name: year_month
columns.description: Partition column, YYYY-MM of the data date
